title: Small Wins
intro: Little things count. Read each prompt and see what comes to mind.

prompts.text: What is a small thing that went right today?
What did you figure out that you did not know this morning?
What is something you did that your past self would be glad of?
What made a task go a little smoother than usual?
What small step did you take that you did not have to?
What is one thing you handled calmly?
What is a tiny improvement you made, like a clearer name or a tidier note?
Which small win would you like to repeat tomorrow?
prompts.followUp: Maybe it is easier to repeat than you think.
